senses.gloss: (v. כרח) to shrink, be narrow, (with or sub. רוחא) to be ill-tempered.—Part. כְּרִי, f. כַּרְיָא (= כריה, כריהא); pl. כְּרִין.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:17">Targ. Prov. XIV, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:29">29</cite> <he>דכ׳ רוחיה</he> (h. text <he>קצר רוח</he>, <he>קצר אפים</he>).—<he>ענבי דכְרִין</he> grapes which shrunk, undeveloped (blackish) grapes.
<cite ref="Nazir 34b">Naz. 34ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="K01123"><he>כְּרוּם</he></cite> ch.
